Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The Bangladesh players make their way out in the middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi and Harnoor Singh are set to open the batting for India. MD Ashiqur Zaman has been handed the responsibility with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then! Just 112-runs needed to win. A couple of days earlier, 134 was defended on the same ground. Can Bangladesh pull off a miracle here? Or will India ease through the chase? We'll find out soon. Stay tuned for the run chase.

Vicky Ostwal is down for a chat. He says that they were quite lucky to win the toss and bowl first as there was a bit of moisture. Says that they have done well to restrict them to 111 and the wicket has gotten better as the game has gone on. He adds that their opponents have a good bowling attack and the key is to play it normally. Mentions that he wanted to make the batters struggle and he is happy that he managed to do so.

It was a sorry display from the bat by Bangladesh! The top scorer came in at number 8. He is the only one who managed to cross the 20-run mark. Speaks volumes about how poor they were. Now though they need to put this behind and concentrate on their bowling. They need a miracle to defend this. Anything other than a India win though will be a huge surprise.

End of an exceptional performance from India! Yes, they will be a tad disappointed they did not get them all out for a lower score but they will feel they are heavy favorites to enter the semi finals. It was their pacers who began things. Ravi Kumar got the wickets first up and Rajvardhan kept it tight. The spinners then came on and kept the good work going. Vicky yet again impressed. There was a partnership in between but once that was broken, India made quick work of the tail.

OUT! TAKEN! Nelson strikes again and Bangladesh Under-19 have been bundled out here. This is banged in short, around off. Tanzim Hasan Sakib looks to take on the pull shot but the ball hurries onto him and he ends up getting a top edge. The ball is skied towards the short leg region and Vicky Ostwal runs in from square leg to take the catch. Rajvardhan Hangargekar has his wicket and Bangladesh Under-19 finish with 111/10!
Commentary.Howout: c Vicky Ostwal b Rajvardhan Hangargekar

Commentary.Commentary: Dragged down, on off. Tanzim Hasan Sakib pulls it down to long off for one.
Nicely bowled! Around off, turning away. Sakib gets beaten as he looks to drive at it.
On off. Blocked out.
Flatter delivery, outside off. Left alone.
On middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Quicker and shorter, around off. This is punched off the back foot on the off side.
Full, on off. This is pushed down the ground for a single.
Ripon Mondol is the last man in for Bangladesh Under-19.

OUT! RUN OUT! They say never run off a misfiled and that saying holds true here. A half-tracker, on middle. MD Ashiqur Zaman pulls it towards the left of deep mid-wicket and Siddharth Yadav over there fumbles. They look for the second but hesitate a bit and Yadav is quick to capitalise. Yadav fires in a throw at the keeper's end and scores a brilliant direct-hit. The appeal is sent upstairs and the replay shows that Zaman is short of his crease. Both set batters are back in the hut now.
Short and wide, Sakib hangs back and pulls it down to long off for a single.
On off, defended out.
Tanzim Hasan Sakib is in at number 10.

OUT! STUMPED! Angkrish Raghuvanshi does the job with his golden arm and SM Meherob perishes after a brilliant fighting knock. Nicely flighted, well outside off. Meherob skips down the track and looks to lift it over long off. He gets completely beaten in flight and the ball turns away as well. Dinesh Bana whips off the bails in a flash and India finally have the 8th wicket. SM Meherob has done his job though.
Commentary.Howout: st Dinesh Bana b Angkrish Raghuvanshi

Commentary.Commentary: A juicy full toss, on middle. Zaman pushes it down towards long on for a single. The fifty partnership is up between these two.
Another one on the stumps, it is pushed to covers.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
On off, defended.
On off, defended.
A single as this is played through point.
Outside off, left alone.
WIDE! Down the leg side, wided.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Another one on the stumps, this is played to the cover fielder.
On off, blocked.
Outside off, not played at.
On off, kept out.
Outside off, left alone.
Shorter and on off, this is guided through point for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Meherob looks to flick but misses.
On middle, blocked.
On off, this is worked through square leg for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side, wided.
FOUR! Up and over! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over mid on for a boundary.
On the pads, Zaman looks to flick but misses. An appeal but turned down.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Slapped hard! This is short and outside off, it is powered through covers. Another boundary. A huge over for Bangladesh.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Meherob looks to sweep, he plays it fine and bags another boundary.
FOUR! Nicely played! On middle, Meherob plays the paddle scoop, it goes over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Just about evades the fielder! The reverse sweep is out, it goes more off the top edge, over point for two.
On the stumps, defended.
Shorter and outside off, Zaman looks to cut but gets an underedge to the keeper.
Outside off, this is guided through point for one.
Solid again! On middle, defended.
On the stumps, kept out.
Another one on the stumps, defended nicely.
On off, blocked.
Ravi Kumar (5-1-5-3) is back on.
On the stumps, defended nicely.
On middle, kept out.
On the off pole, SM looks to sweep, he misses, it hits the pad and goes behind. A single taken.
This is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, defended.
On off, this turns away. Zaman is beaten as he tries to block.

DRINKS! The Indian spinners, especially Vicky Ostwal has been all over the Bangladeshi middle-order and has picked up two wickets as well. The only batter who looked to get Bangladesh to a respectable total, Aich Mollah has also perished but SM Meherob has found the boundary on a couple of occasions as well. To be fair, Bangladesh need a miracle from their tail to get to a score which might give them just that bit of hope. India, on the other hand, will be looking to clean up the tail as soon as possible. Also, Vicky Ostwal (7-1-22-2) is back into the attack.
On the stumps, kept out.
BEATEN AGAIN! On a length and around off, this moves away again. Meherob is beaten.
BEATEN! On middle, this moves away. Meherob looks to defend but is beaten.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Short and wide outside off, SM slashes but misses.
FOUR! Nicely played! Short and on the body, Meherob pulls it all along the ground through backward square leg for a boundary.
Another single as Meherob works it through square leg.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Short and this is pulled through square leg for one.
On off, kept out.
Tossed up, this is played back to the bowler.
On the stumps, kept out.
Another one on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Good length and on off, kept out.
On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, left alone.
On the stumps, this is kept out.
Shorter again, this is guided to point.
Shorter and on middle, defended.
Rajvardhan Hangargekar (5-0-13-0) is back into the attack.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
on middle, blocked.
Outside off, this one turns back in. Left alone though.
On middle, defended.
A single now as this is played through covers.
Fuller and on off, Zaman hits it hard but to mid off for one.
Quicker and flatter, on off. Meherob keeps it out.
FOUR! Cheeky! Around off, SM Meherob gets in position quickly and reverses it fine, past backward point and into the fence.
On a length, spinning into leg. Meherob goes back and flicks it just past leg slip.
Nicely flighted, on middle. Meherob works it onto the leg side.
On off. Kept out.

Edged away! On off, turning away. Zaman edges it past second slip and the ball is racing away into the third man fence. Shaik Rasheed though hunts it down and pulls the ball back in. The batters come back for the third.
On middle, defended.
FOUR! The reverse sweep is out, it is hit over point for a boundary.
MD Ashiqur Zaman is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! That is the last ting Bangladesh would have wanted! Bangladesh in all sorts of trouble now and the batter who was looking decent out there has now fallen. On off, this is slapped towards cover. The fielder runs to his right. The non-striker is off but hs partner is just not interested. The fielder picks it up and throws it to the bowler who takes the bails off.
On the stumps, defended again.
This lands on middle and then spins away. Mehrob looks to defend but it goes off an outside edge, lands short of the second slip fielder.
On the stumps, kept out well.

SIX! That is a huge hit! On middle, Mollah shuffles across and plays the slog sweep, it goes well over the mid-wicket fence. Welcome biggit but they need a lot more and probably this is the way to go about things now.
Another block to this ball on off.
On middle, defended.
A huge appeal but turned down! On middle, Mollah looks to sweep but misses. Maybe a little too high.
On the stumps again, kept out again.
On middle, blocked.
Outside off again, this is slapped to covers.
Shorter and outside off, Meherob loosk to cut but underedges it on the off side.
SM Meherob is in at number 8.
OUT! THAT IS PLUMB IN FRONT! On middle, this one goes on with the arm. Hasan plays outside the line, probably for the turn. He misses and it hits him on the pad. An appeal and the finger is raised.
Outside off, Hasan tries to sweep but misses.
On off, defended.
On off, this lands and moves away. The batter looks to defend but is beaten.
A bye! On middle, this one turns down the leg side. Hasan looks to flick but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and a single is run.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on off, Mollah blocks.
Big, big turn yet again! This lands on off and spins away. Mollah is drawn towards the ball but is beaten.
On off again, this is defended.
Tossed up on off, defended.
A touch shorter, on off. Rakibul Hasan rocks back and punches it straight towards cover.
Around off. Kept out.
Flatter delivery, on middle. Hasan looks to work it leg side but ends up edging it back onto the deck.
Nicely drifted into middle and leg. Blocked out.
Nicely played! Full, around middle. Hasan gets inside the line of the ball and scoops it over the keeper's head. The fielder from first slip goes after it and the batters come back for two with ease.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Hasan works it through the gap at mid-wicket and picks up a couple of runs.
Kaushal Tambe comes into the attack for the first time today.
Pitched up, around off. This is nicely driven on the up but straight towards cover.
Full again, around off. Mollah drives it towards extra cover.
Full, around off. This is pushed behind point for a single by Hasan.
And again! Angled into off from 'round the wicket and just holds the line after pitching. Hasan is once again beaten past the outside edge.
Beauty! This is angled in from around off and on a good length. The ball straightens after pitching and Rakibul Hasan is comprehensively beaten.
A touch short and wide. This is slapped away off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
Rajvardhan Hangargekar (4-0-11-0) is back into the attack.

Brilliant effort in the field. Spinning down the leg side, Hasan looks to sweep and ends up getting a top edge over leg slip. The ball is racing towards the fine leg fence but Yash Dhull chases it down and saves a couple of runs.
Huge appeal but not given! On a length, around off and turning in big time. Hasan puts out a stride to defend but the ball goes off the pads and the leg slip fielder pouches it.
Very full, on off. Mollah drives it down towards long off for a single.
On middle. Blocked off the front foot.
Drifted into off, turning away. Mollah is beaten past the outside edge.
Shorter in length, around off. Mollah manages to keep it out off the back foot.
TWO WIDES! This one pitches on a length, around off and ends up down the leg side. Ostwal is getting a lot of turns here. The ball goes past the leg slip fielder and they cross over as well.
Good-length ball, outside off. Mollah hangs deep and caresses it towards point. End of a maiden over from Raj Angad Bawa.
Around the top of off. Mollah solidly defends it out.
Back of a length, around off. Mollah taps it back onto the deck.
Length again, outside off. No shot offered by Mollah.
A length ball, wide of off stump. Left alone.
Bawa hits the length hard and bowls it around off. Mollah hops and defends it out.
Quicker one, turning in sharply from around off. Hasan manages to keep it out.
Tossed up, full and around off. Hasan looks to drive but gets an inisde edge onto the pads.
The skipper, Rakibul Hasan comes in with his team in a real spot of bother.

OUT! BOWLED! Oh no! What has Md Fahim done here! Quicker and flatter, on off. Fahim pre-meditates and tries to reverse it fine, past the keeper but ends up completely missing the ball. The ball goes on to hit the top of off stump and the coach certainly won't be happy with the shot Fahim just attempted. Vicky Ostwal has his second and India have a firm grip on the match at the moment.
Peach! Vicky Ostwal is wreaking havoc at the moment. Another sharp turner, pitches on off and completely bamboozles the batter.
Flatter one, around off and this is edged past the first slip.
Md Fahim is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Beautifully bowled and Ariful Islam's gritty stay at the crease comes to an end. Nice flight and guile, drifted into off. The ball grips and turns sharply after pitching. Islam is forced into playing at that one and gets completely undone in flight. Islam ends up getting a faint edge and Dinesh Bana takes a sharp catch behind the stumps. Bangladesh Under-19 have to start from square one yet again.
Commentary.Howout: c Dinesh Bana b Vicky Ostwal

Commentary.Commentary: Short and wide, Ariful Islam slaps it hard but straight towards deep backward point. Single taken.
On off. Defended off the front foot.
A bit of hesitation but no harm done in the end. Around off, Islam dabs it towards cover-point with soft hands and looks for the single. His partner though sends him back.
On off, this is defended back to the bowler.
Length again, around off. Islam stays solid in defense.
On a length, outside off. Mollah presses forward and pushes it towards extra cover for a quick single.
Quicker one, on off. Islam cannot get it through the cover region.
Beaten! Nicely flighted, on off. The ball drifts in but turns away after pitching. Islam neither goes front or back and the ball goes agonizingly past the outside edge.
On the pads, Mollah paddles it behind square on the leg side for a single.
A touch quicker, around off and on a nagging length. The ball turns away sharply and Mollah is well beaten.
Fired in full and around off. Mollah pushes it out towards mid off.
Nicely flighted, outside off. This one grips and turns a bit as well. Mollah makes a good leave.

DRINKS! Well, the ball did move early on and Ravi Kumar took full advantage of it. He has knocked over three top-order Bangladeshi batters and has laid the platform well for his team. Ariful Islam and Aich Mollah though have been able to spend some time at the crease and will now look to build up a partnership in order to get their side back into the match.
On a length, outside off. Islam nudges it out on the leg side.
Nicely driven again but straight to the fielder this time. Pitched up, around off and driven towards cover.
On middle, Islam works it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Classy shot and that brings up the first boundary of the innings. Juicy half-volley, around off. Ariful Islam holds the pose as he strokes it effortlessly through covers.
full, on off. Islam pushes it back towards the bowler.
Ariful Islam pulls out late and Raj Angad Bawa is a bit frustrated with that. Just a mosquito or an insect that troubled Islam.
A length ball, angled in from outside off. Islam defends it out.

TWO BYES! Absolute beauty! Ostwal tosses it up, full and around middle and leg. The ball grips and turns away sharply, beating both the batter and the keeper. The fielder from first slip chases it down and they get a couple of byes.
Quicker and flatter, on off. Ariful Islam rocks back and punches it towards long off for one.
Around off. This is pushed towards cover.
A bit of grip and turn. This is pushed outside off and turns away from the batter. Islam watches it all the way and taps it on the off side.
This is pushed through on middle. Islam defends it off the back foot.
Flatter delivery, outside off. Mollah waits for it and pushes it out on the off side with the spin for a quick run.
Vicky Ostwal is brought into the attack now.
In the air...safe! Fuller one, around off. Mollah looks to lift it over extra cover but mistimes it badly. The ball just about clears the diving fielder at mid off and they get a single as well.
WIDE! An attempted slower bumper but this one is well over the batter's head. Wided.
Back of a length, around off. Islam hangs back and turns it through square leg for one.
Uppish but safe! Full and wide, Islam drives it past backward point and comes back for the second as well.
Excellent running! A length ball, on off. Mollah nudges it out on the off side with soft hands and sets off for a quick single.
Back of a length, angled in from outside off. Mollah keeps it down towards short leg.
Again that tennis ball bounce. On a good length, outside off. Mollah is taken aback a bit but has time to leave it alone.
The umpire signals the start of Powerplay 2. As many as 4 fielders can now be kept outside the circle. Powerplay 2 will be in effect from overs 11-40.
Pitched up, around off. Islam stays solid in defense. At the end of the first Powerplay, Bangladesh Under-19 are 20/3!
Full, around off. Islam works it towards short mid-wicket.
Full, outside off and this one too angles across. Islam shoulders arms.
WIDE! After bowling a few inswingers, Kumar looks to angle this one across the right-hander but ends up pushing it way too wide.
Pitched up, around off. Islam defends it out solidly.
Well bowled! Full and tailing in late from around off. Islam manages to squeeze it out.
Fullish ball, around off and shaping back in. Islam looks to defend off the front foot but ends up getting an inside edge.
WIDE! This is spilled down the leg side. Wided.
A length ball, on off. Mollah pushes it on the leg side.
Full again but wide of off stump. Left alone.
A touch fuller, on middle. Mollah pushes it towards silly mid on.
Angling in from around off. Mollah nudges it on the leg side.
Fullish ball, on the pads. Mollah whips it aerially towards deep square leg. Ravi Kumar runs around from deep backward square leg and puts in the dive to keep it down to a couple.
On middle and leg, nudged away towards mid-wicket.

Ravi Kumar is having a word with the physio around the ropes. While celebrating the last wicket, Kumar might have just injured the bowling arm and that is the conversation between him and the physio. Hope he is okay.
On the pads, flicked away towards square leg for a single. End of yet another successful over from Ravi Kumar.
Leg bye! On leg and swinging further down the leg side. Islam looks to work it on the leg side but misses. The ball rolls off the pads towards square leg and they scamper through for a leg bye.
Ariful Islam comes in with Bangladesh in a spot of bother.

OUT! TAKEN! Ravi Kumar is on fire at the moment! This is pitched fuller, around off and on a driving length. Prantik Nawrose Nabil gets sucked into playing the cover drive but once again the away movement is troubling the left-handers here. Nabil gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes straight into the clutches of Kaushal Tambe at first slip. He takes a sharp catch and Ravi Kumar has his third wicket. Bangladesh Under-19 in dire straits at the moment.
Commentary.Howout: c Kaushal Tambe b Ravi Kumar

Commentary.Commentary: Ooh, a bit of an extra bounce now! On a good length yet again, around off. Nabil looks to cut but the tennis-ball like bounce takes him by surprise.
On a good length, outside off and there is still movement in the air. Nabil looks to have a poke at it but gets beaten.
Around off and shaping away. Nabil lets it through to the keeper.
On a good length, well outside off. Mollah isn't interested in playing at that one.
Length again, pushed wider. Mollah gets behind the line of the ball to block.
A touch fuller, outside off. Mollah presses forward and drives it towards cover-point.
A length ball, outside off. Mollah leaves it alone.
Back of a length, on the body. Nabil dabs it down towards backward square leg and picks up a single.
Peach! Pitched up, on middle and the ball angles across the left-hander sharply. Nabil looks to punch it straight back but is comprehensively beaten.
WIDE! Hangargekar goes over the wicket now and spills it down the leg side. Nabil misses the flick and a wide is called.
Very full, on off. Mollah keeps it out. Just a single and a wicket off the over.
On a good length, around off and this one shapes back in. Mollah looks to defend it off the front foot but misses and gets hit on the pads. A stifled appeal but not given.
Aich Mollah is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Soft dismissal and Iftakhar Hossain will be really disappointed with himself. The two Indian pacers kept the pressure on and Hossain was getting bogged down. This is a short and wide one, which should have been put away. Hossain though plays at it a bit tentatively and ends up pushing it straight to Shaik Rasheed at point. Rasheed takes a simple catch and Ravi Kumar has two early wickets.
Commentary.Howout: c Shaik Rasheed b Ravi Kumar

Commentary.Commentary: Hossain wants the single but Nabil sends him back and rightly so. Hossain is finding it difficult to get going and looks to be on the edge a bit. He dabs the length ball down towards point and looks for the quick single which isn't there.
Back of a length, on off. Blocked out.
Good fielding! Short and wide, Nabil hangs back and cuts it to the left of point. Shaik Rasheed dives down to his left and makes a half stop. Single taken.
A yorker-length delivery, on middle. Hossain hangs deep and is able to keep it out.
The keeper seems interested but that's all. Pitched up, outside off and inviting the batter to drive. Hossain looks to do so but gets beaten past the outside edge yet again.
Length again, around the hips. This is tucked away behind square for a single.
Short of a good length, angled into off. Nabil watches it all the way through and leaves it alone.
Full toss, on off. This one just dipped on the batter. Nabil taps it towards point and the fielder over there fumbles. The batters get back for two with ease.
Beaten! Angled into off but the ball straightens after pitching. Nabil dangles his bat at it but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Short and wide, Hossain throws his hands at it but taps it back onto the deck off the toe end of the bat. End of a maiden over from Ravi Kumar.
Another watchful leave by Iftakhar Hossain. A good-length ball, close to off and left alone.
Back of a length, on off. Hossain punches it off the back foot towards point.
Around off. This is pushed towards cover-point.
Kumar pushes this one a bit fuller and bowls it in that corridor of uncertainty. Hossain looks to drive but decides against it.
On a good length, around off. The ball shapes away and the batter makes an easy leave.
And again! Full and close to the off stump. Nabil goes hard at the drive but doesn't make a connection.
That one had some fire behind it. Hangargekar bowls it full and wide. Nabil looks for the extravagant drive but is completely beaten for pace.
Very full, angling into middle and leg. Nabil jams it out towards mid on.
Back of a length, around off. Nabil hops and dabs it down to backward point.
WIDE! Oh, dear! That one slipped out of the hand. Hangargekar looks to bowl it from the back of the hand but ends up serving a wide full toss. The batter is unable to reach it and a wide is called.
WIDE! This is on a length, well outside off and shapes away as well. Wide signalled.
Well timed! This is pitched up, on off. Nabil punches it on the up and gets it through cover-point for a couple. He is up and running now as well.
On the pads, tucked away towards deep backward square leg for one. Iftakhar Hossain is off the mark.
Nicely bowled! This is angled into the channel around off and the ball just holds its line after pitching. Nabil has a poke at it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Around the top of off. Nabil prods and pushes it towards cover.
A length ball, well outside off. Nabil shoulders arms.
Prantik Nawrose Nabil is in at number 3.

OUT! Cleaned up! Ravi Kumar picks up a wicket in his very first over! There is movement through the air and Kumar just pitches it full and on off. The ball tails back in nicely and Mahfijul Islam ends up playing all around it. He looks to flick it away leg side but the ball goes through the gap between bat and pad and crashes into middle stump. India Under-19 have the early breakthrough and Islam has to depart early.
Bye! Good awareness from the non-striker. This is pushed wider and is shaping away. The ball bounces just in front of the keeper and he spills it. They scamper through for a bye.
Good running! Kumar looks to bring it back in from off. Islam tucks it away towards square leg for a quick single.
Ravi Kumar to steam in from the opposite end.
Full and wide, left alone. Just the single off the first over.
The skipper has brought himself into the short leg position for the final delivery of the over. Very interesting. Might be the double bluff.
Full, outside off. Hossain looks for the cover drive but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Back of a length, angled into the body. Hossain manages to fend it away.
Hangargekar comes from 'round the wicket and hurls across a short one. This is angled at the body from outside off but straightens after pitching. Hossain sways away from the line of the ball.
Width on offer. This is slashed away on the bounce to third man for a single. Islam and Bangladesh are underway.

What happened here? A fiery yorker to start with from Rajvardhan Hangargekar. This is tailing in on off and Islam just about gets the toe end of the bat on it. The ball does roll on to hit the wickets but the fails don't fall. The Indians cannot believe it but Islam survives.

Done with the beautiful national anthems and it's time now for the match to get underway. The Indian team is seen in a huddle as they make their way to the middle. The two opening batters for Bangladesh, Iftakhar Hossain and Mahfijul Islam stride out to the middle. Rajvardhan Hangargekar is ready to steam in with the new ball. Oh wait, there's a slight delay. The Indian skipper is seen talking to the umpire about a patch, close to the pitch and the ground staff is out to have a look at it. All good now and the anticipation grows even more. Let's play...

We are minutes away from the start of play. But first the two sides will line up in the middle for their respective national anthems. It will be Bangladesh's national anthem first followed by the Indian national anthem

PITCH REPORT - Samuel Badree is pitchside. Badree says that there's a lot of green grass on the deck and its live grass. There's also a bit of moisture which means that the ball will come onto the bat better but there will be assistance for the seamers early on. He reckons the right decision would be to win the toss and bowl first.

Bangladesh Under-19 captain Rakibul Hasan says that they would have liked to bowl first as well but they know the opponent's strengths and weaknesses. Adds that batting first in big games is not a bad thing and will look to put on a good score on the board. Informs that there are no changes to the side.

Yash Dhull, the Indian skipper says that they will have a bowl first. He mentions that there is a bit of moisture and that will help their seamers. He adds that there are a few changes to the side with him coming in for Sindhu and mentions that they will look to restrict their opponents to a low score.

India Under-19 (Playing XI) - Harnoor Singh, Angkrish Raghuvanshi, Shaik Rasheed (In for Vasu Vats), Yash Dhull (C) (In for Nishant Sindhu), Raj Angad Bawa, Siddharth Yadav (In for Aneeshwar Gautam), Kaushal Tambe, Dinesh Bana (WK), Rajvardhan Hangargekar, Vicky Ostwal and Ravi Kumar.

Bangladesh Under-19 (Unchanged XI) - Mahfijul Islam, Iftakhar Hossain, Prantik Nawrose Nabil, Aich Mollah, Md Fahim (WK), Ariful Islam, SM Meherob, MD Ashiqur Zaman, Tanzim Hasan Sakib, Rakibul Hasan (C) and Ripon Mondol.
TOSS - Up goes the flip of the coin and it lands in favor of India Under-19. They have decided to BOWL first.

Bangladesh on the other hand, were thrashed by England but came back well in the next two games to make it through. They face an extremely tough task ahead of them and will need to be at their best to win this one. Can they do so? We will find out.
India, despite all the problems they have been through in this tournament have looked the side to beat! They are a complete squad with brilliant batsmen and variety in bowling.

It is time to find out the 4th and the final team to make it to the semi finals. The last quarter finals is a repeat of the finals of the last World Cup. It is India taking on Bangladesh. Now when you think of that finals, what comes to your mind is the aggression the two sides played with, the intensity and the fire and we assume it is going to be nothing less in this game. It was Bangladesh who won that encounter and won the trophy for the very first time but India will be out for revenge this time. They are probably favourites but on their given day, Bangladesh are capable of beating anybody. Toss and teams in a bit.
